purpose: Track provenance, access conditions, licenses, and task compatibility before data ingestion or model training.

datasets.title: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Positions Dataset
datasets.limitations: 120,279 labeled images from two athletes across six sparring sequences; 10 positions map to 18 classes. Position labels support descriptive transitions between sampled annotations, not guard-drop labels or continuous dwell-time estimates. Pose detections were automatic and manually verified, but their correctness is not guaranteed. Non-commercial, share-alike terms apply; this is not professional-match coverage.

analysis_approval.reviewer: User selected the ViCoS candidate for non-commercial position analysis in this session

image_training_approval.reviewer: User requested work with image data after selecting the ViCoS candidate
image_training_approval.scope: Exploratory image classification of the dataset's 18 annotated position classes only; not guard-drop prediction or general athlete evaluation.

training_approval.reviewer: User requested training on publicly accessible martial-arts datasets; scope limited to this licensed non-commercial ViCoS position task
training_approval.scope: Train an exploratory classifier for the dataset's 18 BJJ position labels using its precomputed pose1/pose2 coordinates. Not RGB-video training, guard-drop prediction, or general athlete evaluation.

datasets.title: NTU RGB+D 120 Skeleton Data
datasets.limitations: Registration, request, and release agreement required; academic non-commercial research only under the published terms. Not a guard-drop annotation set.

datasets.title: Human3.6M
datasets.limitations: The official description reports 3.6 million 3D poses from 11 actors in 17 everyday-action scenarios with synchronized video, motion capture and body-part labels. Daily-activity data, not combat-performance labels; access and use are subject to the official data-use license agreement and citation requirements.

datasets.title: Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones
datasets.limitations: Daily activities from smartphone inertial sensors; not video skeleton sequences or combat-technique labels.

training_approval.reviewer: User selected UCI HAR in this session; license verified on the UCI dataset page
training_approval.scope: Daily-activity inertial-sensor baseline only. Not combat-technique, fatigue or injury evidence.

datasets.title: HMDB51 Human Motion Recognition Video Dataset
datasets.limitations: 6,849 clips across 51 classes; includes punch, kick someone, fencing and sword fight. General human-action footage rather than BJJ position labels. Review the license scope for each clip and the intended video-derived artifacts.

datasets.title: UCF101 Human Actions Dataset
datasets.limitations: 13,320 YouTube-sourced clips across 101 classes, including Punch, Boxing Punching Bag, Boxing Speed Bag, Fencing, Sumo Wrestling and Tai Chi. The official page does not specify a reuse or model-training license. Respect its source-group split protocol.

datasets.title: AVA Actions and AVA-Kinetics
datasets.limitations: Person/time-localized labels include martial art, fight/hit a person, grab a person and kick a person. Video IDs point to third-party source videos; annotation availability does not grant blanket rights to download or train on those videos.

datasets.title: UCF-Crime
datasets.limitations: 1,900 long untrimmed surveillance videos; Fighting is a coarse anomaly class, not combat-sport technique or grappling labels. Official page does not state model-training or derivative-use terms.

datasets.title: RWF-2000 Violence Detection Video Database
datasets.limitations: 2,000 surveillance clips labeled violent/non-violent. Repository says video files are currently unavailable and prohibits modification/redistribution and commercial use without lab approval; training permission is not established.

datasets.title: COCO Person Keypoints
datasets.limitations: Static-image person keypoints with 17 joints; useful for generic pose-detector work, not action sequences or combat-position classification. Verify official terms and each image's rights/attribution before training.

datasets.title: Penn Action Video Dataset
datasets.limitations: 2,326 RGB sequences across 15 fitness/sports actions, with 13-joint frame annotations. No martial-arts classes, and its skeleton schema differs from ViCoS. Project page provides no explicit reuse or model-training license.

datasets.title: AMASS Motion Capture Archive
datasets.limitations: Unifies 15 marker-based mocap sources into SMPL; over 40 hours, 300+ subjects and 11,000+ motions. Not combat-labeled; constituent datasets and body-model terms may differ. Verify access agreement and component permissions before training.

datasets.title: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
datasets.limitations: 2,605 trials in six broad categories; generic mocap, not combat-sport technique labels. Site permits use in products but prohibits direct resale of data, including converted data; do not crawl and retain the requested acknowledgment.

datasets.title: PhysioNet Wearable Exam Stress Dataset
datasets.limitations: Contains EDA, heart rate, BVP, skin temperature, inter-beat interval and accelerometer data from exam sessions. Not athlete or combat data; must not support sports-fatigue or medical claims without suitable evidence.

datasets.title: ESC-50 Environmental Sound Classification
datasets.limitations: 2,000 five-second clips over 50 environmental classes, including breathing, clapping and footsteps, but no combat-specific sound labels. Dataset license is non-commercial; each source clip has separate attribution/license details.

training_approval.reviewer: User selected ESC-50 in this session; LICENSE file read (CC BY-NC 3.0 dataset; per-clip Freesound attribution in meta)
training_approval.scope: Non-commercial environmental-sound baseline only. No combat-specific impact labels; not strike-force evidence.

datasets.title: FSD50K Human-Labeled Sound Events
datasets.limitations: 51,197 clips across 200 sound classes. Individual clips include CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-NC and CC Sampling+; inspect clip metadata and exclude clips whose terms do not allow the intended training and derivative use. Commercial use requires author contact.

datasets.title: MPII Human Pose Dataset
datasets.limitations: About 25,000 images with over 40,000 people, 410 general activity labels and images extracted from YouTube videos. Not combat-technique labels. The official page does not specify a dataset-wide reuse or model-training license; confirm image/source rights before acquisition or use.

datasets.title: Kinetics-400/600/700
datasets.limitations: Large-scale general action labels refer to YouTube-hosted clips; this is not a dedicated combat-sport technique dataset. The repository does not grant blanket rights to source videos. Verify clip-level rights and avoid cross-version train/test leakage (for example, Kinetics-400 validation videos can overlap Kinetics-700 training).

datasets.title: Google AudioSet
datasets.limitations: 2,084,320 ten-second segments with labels; audio embeddings and annotations are available, while source audio remains linked to YouTube videos. No blanket permission to download or train on the underlying recordings is assumed; not a combat-sound-specific dataset.

datasets.title: GrappleMap grappling technique map
datasets.limitations: Hand-authored technique graph (positions and transitions) by one project; describes possible techniques, not observed match frequencies. Edge counts are not probabilities of real-world transitions.

analysis_approval.reviewer: User selected GrappleMap in this session; LICENSE states contributions released into the Public Domain

datasets.title: Owner's own kickboxing / Muay Thai / BJJ training recordings
datasets.limitations: Unlabelled footage; MediaPipe person indices are not stable identities, so per-athlete metrics need identity tracking first. No guard-drop or performance labels; not approved for model training. Raw video and outputs stay local.

analysis_approval.evidence_ref: Owner attestation in session 2026-10-27: footage shows the owner and adult training partners who agreed to analysis
analysis_approval.consent_scope: local analysis only; no publication of footage or identifiable outputs
